subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

The chef’s (1)____ meal consisted of crispy (2)___, tender meat and a (3)____sauce that delighted everyone at the dinner party.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The chef’s "**delicious**" meal consisted of "**vegetables**", tender meat, and a "**tangy**" sauce that delighted everyone at the dinner party.
 
• The word "**delicious**" describes the meal appropriately.
 
• "**Vegetables**" fits the description of crispy components, and "**tangy**" suits the sauce perfectly.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The chef’s delicious__ meal consisted of crispy __vegetables__, tender meat, and a __tangy__ sauce that delighted everyone at the dinner party.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Tangy**: means having a sharp, strong, or pleasant taste or flavor.
 
• **Delicious**: means highly pleasing to taste.
 
• **Vegetables**: refers to crispy and fresh edible plant components used in meals.
